summary: Iteration 5 regression check after app.json android.minSdkVersion=26 change (native-only fix for react-native-vlc-media-player Gradle manifest-merge failure). No JS/logic changed, and the running web preview + backend confirm NO regressions. BACKEND: full pytest suite re-ran green — 17/17 passed against https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com in 24s (status/source: 688 channels, 665 with EPG; /api/channels unique ids; /api/guide?hours=24 returns channels+programs; /api/search=espn OK; /api/refresh advances last_refresh; auth login case-sensitive success/wrong-case-user/wrong-case-pass/wrong-pass/blank; /api/auth/verify valid/missing/invalid; POST /api/settings requires Bearer, updates URLs, status mirrors new last_refresh — defaults restored). FRONTEND (mobile 390x844 on preview URL): TV Guide loads ~688 channels (688 epg-channel-* rows counted), timeline grid renders with sticky logo column + time header + red now-line on Today; mode-box-btn toggles to box grid (76 box-channel-* tiles visible); mode-timeline-btn returns to timeline. Date picker: 7 chips (date-2026-07-18 .. date-2026-07-24) render — tapping date-2026-07-19 switches window then Today chip returns. Group chips (All/Favorites/Local/Movies) render. Search tab finds channels for query 'espn' (ESPN, ESPN News, ESPN U, ESPN2, ESPN (2), ESPN UHD, ESPN SD, ESPN SHD). Favorites tab loads. Settings shows source status (Channels loaded 688, Channels with EPG 665, Last refreshed timestamp) and settings-refresh-btn taps without crash. Admin flow: admin-unlock-btn reveals admin-username-input + admin-password-input + admin-login-btn; correct CharmCity/CharmCityExotics unlocks and admin-m3u-input prefills with http://m3u4u.com/m3u/jwmzn1grpmu99585n721 (defaults preserved — not saved), admin-logout-btn re-locks back to admin-unlock-btn. Player nav: tapping epg-channel-* opens /player and shows player-back-btn + expected 'Unable to play this stream' overlay (libVLC is native-only in web preview — NOT a failure); player-back-btn returns to guide with all 688 rows intact. React Native issues detected: pointerEvents deprecation warning still fires on load (non-blocking carryover from iterations 1-4). Mixed-content HTTP m3u8 blocked in browser is expected on web (HLS source is http://IP/...). Deprecated packages detected: none new.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN web deprecation warning still logged on app load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Carryover from iterations 1-4. Reference: fires from an overlay/pressable in the frontend tree (likely player or timeline overlay).

action_items: OPTIONAL (unchanged from iter 4): migrate the last props.pointerEvents usage to style.pointerEvents to silence RN web deprecation warning.

The Android APK/AAB Gradle manifest-merge fix (android.minSdkVersion=26 via expo-build-properties in app.json) can only be validated by re-running the EAS Publish/build — cannot be verified from the preview environment.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json expo-build-properties plugin now sets android.minSdkVersion=26 (and keeps usesCleartextTraffic=true) — this satisfies react-native-vlc-media-player's minSdk 26 constraint and should resolve the Gradle 'Manifest merger failed: uses-sdk:minSdkVersion 24 cannot be smaller than version 26' error at build time.
Change is purely a native prebuild config; no runtime JS was touched, so the running Expo web preview is unaffected — confirmed by full backend + UI regression pass.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable regression flows on web preview
